Usage: nemar compute [options] [command]

Use NEMAR compute: ask for access, run jobs, and see your balance, limits, jobs
and results

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Commands:
  balance [options]                  Show your compute access and balance
  cancel [options] <job>             Cancel one of your jobs
  help [command]                     display help for command
  limits [options]                   Show the partitions offered to you and
                                     your limits
  list [options]                     List your compute jobs
  logs [options] <job>               Print the log of a job
  queue [options]                    Show recent queue waits per partition
  request-access [options]           Ask an admin for compute access (one-time)
  results [options] <job>            List, or download, the files a finished
                                     job made
  status [options] <job>             Show one of your compute jobs
  submit [options] [path] [args...]  Run a script, a folder or a container
                                     image on NEMAR compute
